domain: Llama-3-8B-UltraMedical is an open-access large language model (LLM) specialized in biomedicine.
task: Llama-3-8B-UltraMedical is trained on our [UltraMedical](https://github.com/TsinghuaC3I/UltraMedical) dataset, which includes 410,000 diverse entries comprising both synthetic and manually curated samples.
Llama-3-8B-UltraMedical has achieved top average scores across several popular medical benchmarks, including MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MMLU-Medical.
